## License and provenance

Poly Haven states all site assets are CC0; redistribution and commercial use are permitted without attribution. The publisher license is captured in `LICENSE-source.html` and available at https://polyhaven.com/license. Creator names, source links, API metadata, and publisher MD5s are preserved per asset. `SHA256SUMS` covers all included files.

These are generic props/infrastructure, not proof of a particular Yugoslav installation or military design. Check scale, texture settings, collisions, performance, historical fit, and RTS-camera readability. Decorative assets must not silently alter gameplay navigation.
